settings.question: How do I get started after purchasing?
settings.answer: You'll receive an order confirmation email with instructions for submitting your current resume, target job title, and any other relevant background.

settings.question: What file formats will I receive?
settings.answer: An editable Word (.docx) file and a polished PDF, plus a LinkedIn copy document where applicable.

settings.heading: Not Sure This Is the Right Package?
settings.text: Compare all packages side by side to find the best fit for your career stage.
